title: Cargo ship Royad Mammadov sinks off Romania after fire, drone cause unconfirmed
excerpt: The Saint Kitts and Nevis flagged general cargo vessel caught fire and sank near the Pescăruș platform, with two dead and 11 rescued, Romanian maritime rescue ARSVOM said.
